summary: Wihlborgs Fastigheter AB (publ), a property company, owns, develops, rents, and manages commercial properties in the Öresund region, Sweden. Its property portfolio consists of office/retail, logistics/production, and projects/land in Malmö, Helsingborg, Lund, and Copenhagen. Wihlborgs Fastigheter AB (publ) was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Malmö, Sweden.
